reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes Mirror Trading International through recruitment-dependent earning projections, presenting team growth and binary bonuses as a path to financial freedom, including claims such as $330,000 per month. It instructs viewers to recruit others, use sponsors and social media, and contact the promoter, so the disclaimers do not change the video's central solicitation of participation in a multi-level earning structure.

citations.quote: They'll recruit approximately 10 people per month
Spillover happens when your sponsor or someone in the team above you places someone in the leg beneath you.
How about earning $50,000 per day?
The more effort you are able to put into growing your business the quicker you will achieve financial freedom.

opening.argument: Judge, the large earnings figures should be read alongside the video's explicit qualifications. It says the ideas may not work for the viewer, bases projections on current history, and makes bonuses dependent on trading results. It also warns viewers not to count on sponsor spillover before it occurs. Those are material limits on the examples, not promises that a viewer will receive the displayed amounts. The stronger reading is a promotion of a speculative business opportunity whose potential results are presented conditionally.

citations.quote: We cannot guarantee that the ideas shown in this video will work for you.
All projections made in this video, are based on current history. It must be noted that all bonuses are dependent on trading results.
But don't count on spillover until it actually occurs.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited $50,000 question is an invitation to consider an earning scenario, not a statement that everyone will earn it. Likewise, the sponsor-spillover passage expressly cautions against relying on that benefit. Recruitment projections describe assumed activity, but the opening does not establish that the projected bonuses are guaranteed payments.

citations.quote: How about earning $50,000 per day?
However it is not guaranteed. Spillover happens when your sponsor or someone in the team above you places someone in the leg beneath you. But don't count on spillover until it actually occurs.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The qualifications address certainty, not the structure being promoted. The video connects a member's position and a growing weaker leg to a potential weekly binary bonus, then urges viewers to grow their teams to achieve financial freedom. Calling those figures projections does not make recruitment-dependent earnings incidental.

citations.quote: 12 months, number of team members in week a leg, 2,309. Average member position in US dollars, $200. Potential binary bonus per week, $3,232.
The more effort you are able to put into growing your business the quicker you will achieve financial freedom.

opening.argument: Judge, much of the presentation teaches viewers how its networking model is described to work. It distinguishes recruiting patterns for different types of participants, compares potential results over time, and directs viewers to separate material explaining the bonus calculation. It also points to educational videos and support material. That instructional content supports reading this as a business-training presentation: its tables illustrate a model rather than document actual payments to a viewer.

citations.quote: The motivated share the business every other day and this results in them recruiting about five new people per month.
here is a comparison between the steady and fast track with monthly Binary bonus projections added.
For more information on how the Binary bonuses are calculated please refer to the Binary Bonus videos.
Merit Trading International provides you with educational videos and other support material to assist you in building your business.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats explanation of recruiting and sponsor placement as conclusive proof of solicitation. But explaining how participants are grouped and how spillover works is also necessary to understand the model being presented. The opening's quotes do not show that its numerical examples are confirmed earnings; the speaker calls them potential bonuses.

citations.quote: Potential binary bonus per week $106.
Spillover happens when your sponsor or someone in the team above you places someone in the leg beneath you.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The training framing does not separate the lesson from the pitch. The description invites viewers to sign up, while the video tells them to use social media and other promotional methods to gather leads. Its instruction is directed toward building the very recruiting structure used in the earnings projections.

citations.quote: Understanding the potential of the Mirror Trading International business opportunity. Sign up today: ...
Post regularly on your favourite channels like Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn & Twitter. Funnel systems are also effective for gathering leads
12 months, number of team members in week a leg, 2,309. Average member position in US dollars, $200. Potential binary bonus per week, $3,232.

opening.argument: Judge, the presented mechanism is a business opportunity with conditional bonuses, not a demonstrated transfer of money to the speaker. The video says bonuses depend on trading results and describes sponsor spillover as an uncertain way a team position might gain a member. Its closing directs questions to a contact, but the supplied material does not show the viewer being asked to send credentials or pay the speaker to unlock a guaranteed return. Those missing steps matter when assessing what this particular video establishes.

citations.quote: It must be noted that all bonuses are dependent on trading results.
Spillover happens when your sponsor or someone in the team above you places someone in the leg beneath you. But don't count on spillover until it actually occurs.
If you have questions or for more information please contact Clint

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening identifies recruiting, sponsor placement, and ambitious projections, but those points do not by themselves show a credential request, payment to the presenter, or a guaranteed return. The video expressly makes bonuses contingent on trading results. The judge should assess the conduct shown here, rather than supply an unshown transaction.

citations.quote: It must be noted that all bonuses are dependent on trading results.
Spillover happens when your sponsor or someone in the team above you places someone in the leg beneath you.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A credential request or payment to the presenter is not needed to identify the mechanism this video promotes. It explicitly links a $200 average member position and thousands of team members in the weaker leg to a potential binary bonus, and the description asks viewers to sign up. The defense's missing steps do not erase the recruitment-dependent earnings pitch that is present.
